description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AnySoftKeyboardSwipeListener' that handles swipe gestures for the AnySoftKeyboard input method. It manages gesture configurations, animations, and key actions based on user gestures such as swipe directions, pinch, and separate gestures, integrating with preferences and external resources.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardSwipeListener
classes.description: An abstract class that extends 'AnySoftKeyboardPopText' to handle swipe gestures, pinch, and separate gestures for the keyboard, including configuration and animation handling.

methods.name: getIntFromSwipeConfiguration
methods.description: Converts a string configuration value into a corresponding key code.

methods.name: subPrefs
methods.description: Subscribes to preference changes for gesture actions and updates internal key code variables accordingly.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes gesture configurations, preferences, and animation settings during the creation of the listener.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, particularly the switch animator, when the listener is destroyed.

methods.name: doOnKeyForGesture
methods.description: Executes a key action based on the provided key code, simulating a key press.

methods.name: onSwipeRight
methods.description: Handles right swipe gesture, executing the appropriate key action based on the initial key and gesture type.

methods.name: onSwipeLeft
methods.description: Handles left swipe gesture, executing the appropriate key action based on the initial key and gesture type.

methods.name: onSwipeDown
methods.description: Handles downward swipe gesture, executing the configured key action.

methods.name: onSwipeUp
methods.description: Handles upward swipe gesture, executing the configured key action.

methods.name: onPinch
methods.description: Handles pinch gesture, executing the configured key action.

methods.name: onSeparate
methods.description: Handles separate gesture, executing the configured key action.

methods.name: onFirstDownKey
methods.description: Records the primary code of the first key pressed to determine gesture behavior.
